text:
Nina (Design): quick idea: inline rollback sheet anchored to the timeline row instead of modal/drawer. sketch: https://figma.redwood/design/rollback-sheet-inline
Omar (PM): inline seems less disruptive. concern: accidental rollbacks.
Kai (A11y): SR note: make sheet a region with aria-label "Rollback sheet for version v3.2". announce open with aria-live polite. default focus should be Cancel.
Dev (Eng): implementable. will add idempotency key and server-side lock. respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Ivy (Research): in tests inline reduces mis-clicks and preserves context. users want explicit percent shown for canaries.
Nina (Design): microcopy options: "Revert to previous" (collapsed), then show "Undo available for 3 minutes". consensus?
Omar (PM): vote for that wording. also require typed confirm for >30% traffic changes.
